## Goal

<a id="WrittenOnce"></a>

### Commands every project runs, written once

`WrittenOnce` · `src/product.ts:15`

What a project asks of its graph at a terminal is a command written once here, on std's ports of the engine, which each project chooses: it works with the graph as freely as the engine's own commands did, and changes with a version of the library.
